terra.problem: Saying the song goes to everybody goes beyond David's words that he will praise God among the nations and peoples.
The claim that nobody needs to brace themselves adds an assurance the passage does not give.
The tidy batch line makes the structure of God's speech the joke.
Papa comments on how he is handling the passage when he says he will not add a feeling.
Packing for a wall is an unclear comparison and doesn't land as a joke.
The tools comparison puts God in the role of someone handed a job. Comparisons must stay on the human side.
David says human help is worthless, not that help cannot come from people.
Papa comments on how he is handling the passage when he says he will not add another reason.
